table.censusHint: The census is a shallow estimate grouped by defining type module. Select a row for import, object-type and graph details.

imports.title: Load-time import cost
imports.desc: RSS deltas are recorded only during startup; page refreshes do not keep wrapping the import function.
imports.accounting: Plugin modules plus packages first loaded during startup
imports.coverageSub: Only plugins first loaded after the hook was installed are measurable
imports.packageHint: A shared package is listed under its first importer and is not charged again to later plugins.
imports.empty: No import records to show; restart to cover more plugins.

audit.title: Top-level dependency audit
audit.desc: Find heavy packages imported at module scope. Moving optional work into a function can reduce startup memory.
audit.notRun: Not run yet; the first report normally creates a cache.
audit.empty: No heavy dependency with a known cost was found
audit.unknown: Third-party modules without a measured cost were also found:
audit.pendingTail: not scanned; run again to continue

census.title: Live object census
census.notRun: Not run; this is the only operation that walks the GC object list. It is off by default.
census.sampled: This is a sampled estimate scaled by the sample rate.
census.limit: Only shallow sizes of GC-tracked objects are counted; do not add this to RSS.
census.warning: Make sure a short pause is acceptable. On a small VPS with swap, the walk may fault pages back in.

help.title: How to read the numbers
help.rss: RSS is the process memory currently resident in physical RAM. It is the best first signal for a small VPS nearing pressure, but it cannot identify which plugin owns those pages.
help.import: Import cost is the RSS delta around a plugin's first load and is useful for finding large startup dependencies. Shared packages are listed under the first importer, so this is not current exclusive usage.
help.census: The census groups live objects by the module that defines their type and counts shallow sizes. Bytes, strings, and many C-extension buffers may not appear at all.
help.retained: The reference scan walks outward from plugin instances and modules to estimate objects still reachable while the plugin remains loaded. It is budgeted and is a lower bound, not an exact bill.
help.trend: Trend is a recent sample slope shown per hour. Plugin curves use only census samples; the process RSS curve works even when every plugin probe is off.
help.cgroup: The cgroup values come from Linux. When present, the cgroup limit is more relevant than whole-host system percentage for a containerized AstrBot.

safety.keepCensusOff: Keep the object census off by default; run it only while investigating so a large heap is not scanned periodically.
safety.watchSwap: Watch swapped memory and RSS together. Rising swap is often more urgent than any per-plugin estimate.
safety.useRssAlert: On a small VPS, start with process RSS and RSS-growth thresholds; they do not depend on plugin attribution.
safety.runDeepManually: Run the reference scan only during an investigation and expect a short pause.
